evals.prompt: This is a proof of concept. I do not see Algolia or any full text search. Customers do not search yet.
evals.expected_output: Says search is not set. Does not recommend Algolia. Does not add Supabase full text yet.
assertions: Does not add Supabase full text yet

evals.prompt: Customers search the product. A Supabase migration runs full text search. They have not said it is failing them. I do not see Algolia.
evals.expected_output: Says full text in Supabase is the search. Says that is enough. Does not recommend Algolia.
assertions: Says full text in Supabase is the search

evals.prompt: Algolia is in the app. .env has ALGOLIA_ADMIN_KEY and ALGOLIA_SEARCH_KEY. I am not logged into Infisical.
evals.expected_output: Names the admin key and the read token. Says Infisical is unseen. Does not print either value.

evals.prompt: The browser client reads ALGOLIA_ADMIN_KEY from env and uses it to search.
evals.expected_output: Says the admin key is in the wrong place because client code reads it. Does not print the value. Does not move the key.
assertions: Says the admin key is in the wrong place

evals.prompt: mcp.json names a algolia server. I cannot see anything calling it. Can we go deeper on algolia?
evals.expected_output: Says the MCP setup is there. Says use is unseen. Does not say they can go deeper. Does not print a URL or a token. Does not add the server.
assertions: Says the MCP setup is there
Does not say they can go deeper
Does not print a URL or a token
